topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well, there's news from the village that's warmed my heart like the first sun after a long, cold stretch. Old Ma Baker's house, that cozy little place by the stream, has been left to her grandchildren, Sarah and Thomas. It's good to know that her spirit will live on in those walls, with young folks to tend the garden and keep the hearth. I can see it now, like a patch of ripe wheat, thriving under their care. They'll have stories to tell, sitting by the fire on winter evenings, just like their grandmother did. May the saints bless them and the old house, keeping them safe and sheltered. It's a fine thing, passing on what's dear to us.
